Subject: Budget range validation - token volumes & procurement next steps

Hi Emily / Tom,

Thanks again for your time earlier — great conversation. Quick recap + a couple of asks so we can size the right offering and put together a formal quote: 

What I heard on the call:
- Primary use: document ingestion + QA + a lightweight assistant for support routing (~512 token context for most queries).
- Expected steady-state traffic: 1.5M to 4M inferenced tokens/day (peaks up to ~7M/day during launches).
- Burndown plan: pilot for 2 months at lower QPS, then ramp to prod in Q3.

Info we need to finalize pricing: 
1) Monthly spend band you expect (ballpark is fine) — e.g., $10k-50k/month, $50k-150k/month, etc.
2) Target unit economics — is there a target $/1M tokens that procurement / finance is aiming for?
3) Procurement thresholds: at what monthly or annual commitment level do you require PO/SOW/MSA + RFP?

Next steps from our side: I will draft a 1-page pricing summary and MAP, and attach a preliminary pricing spreadsheet (Redwood-pricing-sheet-v1.xlsx). If you can confirm the monthly spend band and any target $/1M tokens, I'll update the quote and include options (hosted vs. dedicated).

Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync next Tue 3/16 to review the pricing options.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien

Thanks Connor — good recap. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Token volumes: the numbers you listed are in the right range. For budgeting I'd expect:
  - Pilot (months 1-2): ~45M tokens/month
  - Post-pilot (prod): ~120M-220M tokens/month depending on feature adoption

- Target unit economics: Finance is hoping to land somewhere between $20-$35 per 1M tokens for the hosted offering. If a dedicated/reserved option changes that number materially we should see both options.

- Monthly spend band: internally, we're looking at an initial band of $5k-$25k/month during pilot and $25k-$100k/month when we go to prod. Final approval will depend on procurement thresholds below.

Appreciate the spreadsheet — will review and give feedback. Can we also get a simple per-1M-token line in the 1-pager that shows both hosted and dedicated ($/1M tokens) plus estimated latency SLA expectations? That helps our infra folks.

—Emily

Connor / Emily — quick procurement notes from my side so you can bake into the quote: 

- Procurement thresholds:
  - Any recurring spend > $30k/month requires procurement review + written SOW and our legal team to sign MSA redlines.
  - Commitments > $100k/year trigger an RFP process (3 bids preferred).
  - Payment terms: Net-30; vendor must accept standard Spectra PO flow.

- Finance preference: multi-month discounts are preferred (quarterly/annual) but pilot must remain cancellable with 30 days notice.

- Contacts: procurement@spectra-systems.com (procurement lead: Michelle Park) — please include Michelle once you have a draft SOW/quote.

Can you send a concise one-page pricing summary and the spreadsheet in an editable format? Also include an estimated timeline for onboarding and any prerequisites for dedicated deployments (network/VPC, key management).
